finding: The root panel's 'New collection' row sends the user to the FIELDS screen of an existing collection instead of the create-collection wizard, so the module's headline job starts on the wrong screen.
evidence: Reaction on 148:2 child 'Row · New collection' --ON_CLICK--> 151:2 'Content · fields'; in code the same row calls onCreateCollection (ContentViews.tsx:193-198) -> ContentTab.tsx:239 -> StudioPanels.tsx:446 -> CMSCollectionSetupModal, whose board is 1170:4713
fix: Repoint the 'Row · New collection' ON_CLICK from 151:2 to 1170:4713 (Content · collection-setup (modal)).

finding: The empty state's only call to action, 'Create a collection', carries no reaction of its own; the frame-level edge takes the click to a already-populated collection, so a first-time user never sees the wizard.
evidence: 149:7 outbound edges are exactly two: frame-level --ON_CLICK--> 149:50 'Content · collection', and hotspot/state --> 453:4010. Screenshot of 149:7 shows the accent-text CTA; code renders it as a Button calling onCreateCollection (ContentViews.tsx:155-162)
fix: Give the 'Create a collection' text node its own ON_CLICK --> 1170:4713 so the empty state reaches the wizard.

finding: The create-collection wizard has exactly one inbound edge, and it comes from a state chip on the collection-DETAIL board — a screen you can only reach once you already own a collection. Neither real entry point (root row, empty-state CTA) reaches it.
evidence: Inbound scan of page 1:3: the only edge into 1170:4713 is 149:50 'hotspot/state · Content · collec' --ON_CLICK--> 1170:4713. See also W-C-01 and W-C-02
fix: Add the two real edges (W-C-01, W-C-02); keep the state chip as the reviewer shortcut.

finding: The modal's '+ Add record' jumps to the 280-wide sidebar record panel, but in code it opens an inline add-record form inside the same modal — the reviewer is thrown to a different surface than the product shows.
evidence: 1170:4773 'btn/＋ Add record' --ON_CLICK--> 149:84 'Content · record'; code: CMSRecordsModal.tsx:404 onClick={startAdd} -> :123-127 setEditingId("") -> :273-284 renders collection.fields.map(renderField) inside ModalBody
fix: Build the modal inline add/edit form board (W-C-27) and repoint 1170:4773 at it.

finding: The empty-collection board drops the 'Fields ›' / 'Dynamic pages ›' footer that the populated board draws, so from a brand-new collection — the exact state where you still need to define fields — there is no drawn route to Fields.
evidence: Screenshot 1705:8286 shows crumb, '0 records / + Add', empty line and nothing else; 149:50 screenshot shows the footer; CollectionView renders that footer unconditionally (ContentViews.tsx:259-262). 1705:8286's only outbound edge is frame-level --> 149:84
fix: Add the Fields / Dynamic pages footer rows to 1705:8286 and wire Fields --> 151:2.

finding: Saving a NEW record with Published on creates the record, then fails validation on the publish step — leaving an orphan draft behind and the view still in 'new record' mode, so pressing Save again creates a SECOND record.
evidence: useContentPanel.ts:161-168 createContentItem then updateContentItem({status}); CollectionManager.ts:301-307 throws CMSValidationError only on the publish step; the throw escapes saveRecord so ContentTab.tsx:269-272 never reaches setView, and RecordView catches it at ContentViews.tsx:423-429 leaving view.recordId null
fix: Validate before create, or adopt the created id (setView to the new recordId) inside the catch so a retry updates instead of re-creating.

finding: DEAD. The three 'btn/Delete record' buttons are unwired, and no other board in the module draws a delete control at all — so 'delete a record' cannot be completed anywhere in this prototype, though the product supports it in two places.
evidence: Census: 1744:8400, 1744:8407, 1744:8414 'btn/Delete record' with no reaction on themselves or any ancestor. Screenshots of 149:84 and 149:108 show no delete affordance. Code has it twice: CMSRecordsModal.tsx:378 remove(item.id) and ContentViews.tsx:372-379 -> ConfirmDialog :381-392
fix: Wire all three to a new 'Modal · CMS records · delete-confirm' board, and draw the 'Delete record' link on 149:84 that ContentViews.tsx:372-379 renders.

finding: DEAD. The three 'btn/Edit record' pencil buttons are unwired and the screen they need — the modal's inline record form — is not drawn anywhere in the file.
evidence: Census: 1744:8398, 1744:8405, 1744:8412; code destination is CMSRecordsModal.tsx:375 startEdit(item) -> :128-132 -> :273-284 inline field form with Save/Cancel
fix: Build the inline form board (W-C-27) and wire all three pencils to it.

finding: DEAD. 'btn/Publish' is unwired, which orphans the publish-error board from the only control that can produce it — 1706:8451 is reachable only from a reviewer state chip.
evidence: Census: 1744:8410 'btn/Publish' unwired. Its two outcomes both exist in code: CMSRecordsModal.tsx:368 setStatus -> :161-174, which catches CMSValidationError and renders the inline row error at :384-390 (screenshot 1706:8451 shows exactly that copy). The only inbound edge to 1706:8451 is 1170:4749 'hotspot/state · CMS records · pu'
fix: Wire 1744:8410 --> 1706:8451 (the validation-failure outcome, which is what the sample row 'Tiramisu — missing photo' sets up).

finding: DEAD. The two 'btn/Unpublish' buttons are unwired and no board draws the resulting state (a row that has flipped back to draft), so unpublish cannot be seen to work.
evidence: Census: 1744:8396, 1744:8403. Code: CMSRecordsModal.tsx:368 toggles status published<->draft, :373 flips the label, and CollectionManager.ts:319-320 emits CMS_CONTENT_UNPUBLISHED
fix: Draw a 'Modal · CMS records · row-unpublished' variant and wire both buttons to it.

finding: DEAD, and missed by the census because they are TEXT nodes: the four '🗑' glyphs on the wizard's field rows remove a field in code but do nothing on the board.
evidence: Nodes 1753:8397, 1753:8405, 1753:8413, 1753:8421 are TEXT '🗑' with no reaction on themselves or an ancestor (1170:4713's only reactions are btn/Create collection and btn/Cancel). Code: CMSCollectionSetupModal.tsx:397-413 Button onClick={() => removeField(field.id)} -> :156-158
fix: Rename them btn/Remove field, give them the row-removed destination, or mark them spec-only.

finding: The '⠿' drag handles on the wizard's field rows read as reorder affordances but are decoration in code too — field order is positional and there is no way to change it after typing.
evidence: Board nodes 1753:8391 / 8399 / 8407 / 8415; code renders the same glyph aria-hidden with no drag handler (CMSCollectionSetupModal.tsx:378) while order is taken from array position (:203 order: fields.indexOf(field))
fix: Either implement reorder or drop the handle from both board and code — a handle that cannot drag is a promise the screen does not keep.

finding: The step bar's completed 'Name & Type' pill reads as a back-to-step-1 tab and is unwired — and step 1 has no board to go back to.
evidence: 1173:4816 'step1' / 1173:4819 'Name & Type' carry no reaction; step 1 is a real screen in code (CMSCollectionSetupModal.tsx:296-355, name + content type + description) with no board in section 1776:8376
fix: Build the step-1 board (W-C-31) and wire the pill to it.

finding: FINE as a wiring question — the layer is named '[not-implemented] Import JSON' and does carry a reaction — but the board is the only place this control exists: the code deliberately omits the button, so the board over-promises a capability.
evidence: 1170:4771 '[not-implemented] Import JSON — CMSRecordsMo' RX1 --ON_CLICK--> 151:46 'Content · data-sources'; CMSRecordsModal.tsx:396-402 explains the engine exposes createContentItem one record at a time with no bulk/JSON import path and renders no such button
fix: No wiring change. Keep the [not-implemented] tag; decide whether the button should be drawn disabled or removed until a bulk-import path exists.

finding: The record form has no control for image, date or reference fields — everything that is not boolean/textarea/richtext falls through to a plain text box, so a user with a Photo field types a path by hand while a full media library sits one rail away.
evidence: ContentViews.tsx:343-357: boolean -> ToggleSwitch, textarea|richtext -> Textarea, else TextInput type={f.type==="number"?"number":"text"}. Board 151:2 draws 'photo · Image' and 'category · Reference'; board 149:84 draws only Name/Price/Description, so no board covers these either. The modal at least maps date -> input type=date (CMSRecordsModal.tsx:222); the sidebar does not
fix: Draw and build a media-picker control for image, a date control for date/datetime, and a record-picker for reference on the record form.

finding: 'Rich text' is offered as a field type on two boards and in the panel, but every rich-text field is edited as a plain textarea — there is no rich-text control anywhere.
evidence: Board 151:2 row 'description · Rich text'; board 1170:4713 node 1753:8419 'Rich text'; code: ContentViews.tsx:343-349 and CMSRecordsModal.tsx:196-207 both render a Textarea for type richtext
fix: Either draw and build a rich-text control on the record form, or rename the type 'Long text' on both boards and in FIELD_TYPE_LABEL (ContentViews.tsx:449).

finding: A 'Reference' field can never point at anything: the property that names the target collection has no writer and no reader anywhere in the source.
evidence: referenceCollection is declared at packages/editor/src/shared/types/cms.ts:45 and appears nowhere else in packages/editor/src or packages/shared (verified by repo grep). FieldsView collects only name/type/required (ContentViews.tsx:466, 522-561), so the target is never asked for. Board 151:2 draws 'category · Reference'
fix: Add a 'references which collection?' select to the add-field form and persist referenceCollection; draw it on 151:2's add-field state.

finding: select and multiselect field types are unreachable from the editor: nothing anywhere sets CMSField.options, so the record form's option-list branch can never run.
evidence: CMSField.options declared at shared/types/cms.ts:44; FIELD_TYPES in ContentViews.tsx:441 omits select/multiselect; CMSCollectionSetupModal.tsx:47 omits them too; CMSRecordsModal.tsx:209 renders a Select only when field.options?.length, which no code path can satisfy
fix: Either add an options editor to the add-field form (and the two types to FIELD_TYPES), or delete the dead branch and the two types from CMSFieldType.

finding: 'Slug' is offered as a field type and drawn as required on the board, but it is not a member of CMSFieldType — it is cast into the model and gets no uniqueness or format validation, while the dynamic-pages URL pattern resolves against it.
evidence: ContentViews.tsx:441 FIELD_TYPES includes "slug"; CMSFieldType (shared/types/cms.ts:7-22) does not; useContentPanel.ts:190-196 casts type as CMSCollection["fields"][number]["type"]; validateFieldValue's switch (shared/types/cms.ts:191-234) has no slug case; ContentViews.tsx:633-634 matches {key} placeholders against field slugs. Board 151:2 draws 'slug · Slug · required'
fix: Add "slug" to CMSFieldType with a uniqueness + format check in validateFieldValue, and draw the duplicate-slug error state on the record form.

finding: The create-collection wizard can only make five field types, so it cannot produce the 'Rich text' field its own board draws, nor the Reference/Slug/Long text types the Fields screen lists one step later.
evidence: CMSCollectionSetupModal.tsx:47 FIELD_TYPES = Text, Number, Image, Date, Boolean and typeMap at :175-181 mirrors it; board node 1753:8419 draws a row typed 'Rich text'; ContentViews.tsx:441 offers nine types on the next screen
fix: Bring the wizard's type list to the same nine as FIELD_TYPES in ContentViews.tsx:441 — one list, one home.

finding: The wizard's 'Content type' select — the half its own step bar is named for — is collected into state and then dropped: nothing reads it, nothing persists it, and the server schema has no home for it.
evidence: CMSCollectionSetupModal.tsx:112 useState<ContentType>, :322-334 renders the Select, and handleCreate (:168-227) never reads contentType — createCollection is called with (name, undefined, description) at :190-194. upsertCollectionInput (packages/shared/schemas/cms.ts:19-34) has no such field. Board step label 1173:4819 reads 'Name & Type'
fix: Either map the four content types to a starter field set / icon and persist it, or remove the select and rename the step 'Name'.

finding: The template page a dynamic-page collection needs is settable only while creating the collection. The Dynamic pages screen tells the user this is the blocker and gives no control to clear it — the job dead-ends.
evidence: CMSCollectionSetupModal.tsx:208-214 is the only writer of pageTemplatePath; ContentTab.tsx:311-313 saves only pageSlugPattern; DynamicPagesView renders only a URL-pattern input (ContentViews.tsx:641-650) yet warns 'No template page is bound, so publishing emits none of these yet.' at :682-686, citing cms.service.ts:234 which selects on pageTemplatePath NOT NULL. pageSeoTitle / pageSeoDescription (packages/shared/schemas/cms.ts:31-32, board node 1173:4830) are equally write-once
fix: Add Template page, SEO title and SEO description inputs to the Dynamic pages screen and to its (missing) board, saved through updateCollection alongside pageSlugPattern.

finding: Nothing lets a user choose which field titles a record. displayField is read by four surfaces and written only by the e-commerce preset, so record rows silently fall back to field[0] or to 'Record 4f2a'.
evidence: Read at ContentViews.tsx:230 and :312, CMSRecordsModal.tsx:74, BindingPopover.tsx:298; declared shared/types/cms.ts:70 and packages/shared/schemas/cms.ts:26; the only writer in src is ProductCollectionService.ts:74
fix: Add a 'Title field' select to the Fields screen (151:2) writing collection.displayField.

finding: The records modal's record form has no error state at all: editing an already-published record so a required value goes blank throws, and the save handler has no catch — the form sits there, the change is lost, and the user is told nothing.
evidence: CMSRecordsModal.tsx:134-148 save() is try { create/update } finally { setBusy(false) } with no catch; CollectionManager.ts:301-307 throws CMSValidationError whenever the resulting status is published, which it is for an already-published row; the sibling setStatus at :161-174 does catch and renders :384-390. No board draws a form-level error — the four alt states are no-collections, none-published, empty, publish-error
fix: Catch CMSValidationError in save(), mark the offending fields, and draw the state on the (missing) modal form board.

finding: Six documented per-field properties have no editor: description, placeholder, helpText, defaultValue, and the min/max/minLength/maxLength/pattern validation rules. The record form renders placeholders nothing can set.
evidence: CMSField and CMSFieldValidation at shared/types/cms.ts:25-49; the add-field form collects name, type and required only (ContentViews.tsx:466, 522-561); validateFieldValue enforces min/max/length/pattern (shared/types/cms.ts:192-227) against values no UI can supply; CMSRecordsModal.tsx:204 and :232 pass field.placeholder
fix: Add an advanced block to the add-field form for the validation rules the validator already enforces, and draw it on 151:2's add-field state.

finding: A collection's icon is part of the model and the server contract but is never collected, so every row in the Collections list shows the same table glyph.
evidence: icon declared shared/types/cms.ts:68 and packages/shared/schemas/cms.ts:25; no writer in packages/editor/src (repo grep); ContentViews.tsx:182 hardcodes <Table2 size={16} />
fix: Either add an icon picker to the wizard or drop icon from the schema.

finding: The records modal's own record form — the destination of '+ Add record' and of all three Edit buttons, and the only place the modal collects field values — is not drawn anywhere. It is the single missing screen that blocks the most jobs.
evidence: CMSRecordsModal.tsx:273-284 renders collection.fields.map(renderField) plus 'Add record'/'Save'/'Cancel' whenever editingId !== null; section 1776:8376's only modal boards are 1170:4749 and its four alt states (no-collections, none-published, empty, publish-error)
fix: Duplicate 1170:4749, replace the table with the field form, and add a validation-error variant (W-C-24).

finding: The collection board draws a 'Dynamic pages ›' row and the file draws no destination, yet the screen is fully built — including three warning states a user will actually meet.
evidence: Screenshot 149:50 shows the row; ContentViews.tsx:600-726 DynamicPagesView with pattern input, published-count line, unknown-key warning (:675-681) and no-template warning (:682-686); wired at ContentTab.tsx:256 and :299-319
fix: Build the board with all four body states (no pattern, generates N, unknown key, no template bound) and wire 149:50's row to it.

finding: There is no board for the blank new-record form. Every record board draws a filled record, so the state a user lands in the moment they press '+ Add' is undrawn — including its 'New record' crumb and its always-on save bar.
evidence: 149:84 and 149:108 screenshots both show 'Margherita' filled; ContentTab.tsx:254 onAddRecord sets recordId null; ContentViews.tsx:315 titles it 'New record' and :402 shows the save bar whenever (dirty || !record)
fix: Duplicate 149:84, empty every value, title the crumb 'New record', and keep the save bar visible.

finding: The delete confirmation is undrawn on both surfaces, and the sidebar and modal disagree about whether one exists at all — the modal deletes immediately, and CMS records are not on the undo stack.
evidence: ContentViews.tsx:381-392 ConfirmDialog 'Delete record?' / "This one can't be undone"; CMSRecordsModal.tsx:378 calls remove(item.id) with no confirmation; CollectionManager.ts:328-337 deletes outright
fix: Draw the confirm and use it in the modal too — one delete gesture, one guard.

finding: Only step 2 of the two-step create wizard is drawn. Step 1 — the screen that collects the collection's name, content type and description — has no board, so the create job's first screen is unreviewed.
evidence: Board 1170:4713 is titled 'Fields for Menu items' with step1 already ticked (1173:4817 '✓'); CMSCollectionSetupModal.tsx:296-355 renders the step-1 body (name, content type, description) behind step===1
fix: Duplicate 1170:4713, swap the body for the three step-1 inputs, and wire 'Next: Add Fields' to 1170:4713.

finding: The Fields screen's two interactive states are undrawn: the inline add-field form (the only way to add a field after creation) and the 'Delete field?' confirm that warns values are removed from every record.
evidence: 151:2 screenshot shows only the resting list and a '+ Add field' link; ContentViews.tsx:522-562 renders the inline form (name input, type select, required checkbox, Cancel/Add) and :569-580 the ConfirmDialog quoting "and its values on every record will be removed"
fix: Draw both states on duplicates of 151:2 and wire '+ Add field' to the form.

finding: The records table — the module's only bulk view and its only publish/unpublish control — has no door: in the file it hangs off a reviewer state chip, and in the product it can only be opened by typing a command.
evidence: Inbound scan: the only non-alt-state edge into 1170:4749 is 149:84 'hotspot/state · Content · record'. In code the modal opens only on EVENTS.CMS_MANAGE_RECORDS (useEditorEventListeners.ts:90-98), emitted from exactly one place — the command palette entry 'Manage CMS records' (useCanvasCommandPalette.ts:165-172). No panel, rail or menu opens it
fix: Add an entry point from the collection screen (149:50) — e.g. a 'Manage records' action beside '+ Add' — and wire the board edge to match.
